content: High severity reentrancy occurs when a withdraw function sends ETH with call before updating the user balance. The recommended fix is checks-effects-interactions or a nonReentrant modifier.
Access control findings occur when privileged functions can be called without onlyOwner or role-based authorization. Add explicit modifiers and tests for unauthorized callers.
Unchecked external calls happen when low-level call or send return values are ignored. Require the success boolean and handle revert data to prevent silent failures.
Dangerous delegatecall appears when a contract delegates execution to user-controlled targets. Restrict delegatecall targets with an allowlist and avoid loops over untrusted targets.
